business.scenario_title: Delayed Customer Payments & Acute Cash-Flow Pressure
business.scenario_summary: Electrical switchgear distributor facing severe working-capital lockup: ₹1,12,450.00 available cash against ₹2,25,000.00 in urgent supplier bills (overdue + due within 7 days) and ₹4,85,000.00 in outstanding receivables (including a >90-day overdue invoice excluded from baseline simulator recovery).
demonstrated_capabilities: Active Cash Coverage Warning (`Overdue Payables + 7-Day Bills > Available Cash`)
Severe customer payment delays across multiple risk tiers and >90-day aged receivable exclusion in Risk Simulator
Immediate baseline cash shortfall within the 30-day Risk Simulator horizon even before stress sliders are applied
Multi-instalment partial supplier bill payments and overdue supplier obligations
